crumbs.name: Knowledge Based Professions and their Future

children.name: Invoice Capture and Coding
children.blurb: Invoice capture and coding is the process of turning supplier invoices, whether paper, PDF, or e-invoice, into structured payable records and assigning the correct general ledger, cost center, tax, and payment terms.

children.name: Customer Credit Risk
children.blurb: Customer credit risk is the chance that a business customer will not pay what it owes under agreed terms, and it sits on the receivables side of payables and receivables.

children.name: Programmable Settlement and Escrow
children.blurb: Programmable settlement and escrow covers the use of software rules to hold, release, and reconcile funds between parties in payables and receivables.

children.name: Collections and Payment Plans
children.blurb: Collections and payment plans cover the work of recovering overdue receivables and structuring scheduled payments, whether a customer needs an installment plan or a vendor needs a revised payables schedule.

children.name: Working Capital Timing
children.blurb: Working capital timing covers when cash actually moves in and out of a business, not just when an invoice is dated.

sections.body: Payables and receivables is the operational side of accounting that tracks money a company owes and money owed to it. AI is used to read invoices, extract line items, match them to purchase orders, and route exceptions. It scores customers for credit risk using payment history and external signals. It can trigger programmable settlement and escrow when conditions are met. It also helps design collections sequences and payment plans. It forecasts working capital timing by learning from past payment behavior.
sections.heading: What this covers

sections.body: Some tasks are largely solved: optical character recognition plus language models can capture invoices and code them to accounts with high accuracy on clean, digital documents, and matching and approval workflows are often automated. Credit risk scoring is mature in consumer and small business contexts, but it struggles with thin files and opaque supply chains. Collections remain partly human because negotiation and hardship need judgment. Programmable settlement is technically possible but limited by bank rails, legal enforceability, and interoperability. Working capital timing is forecastable but not certain, because customer behavior and macroeconomic shifts can break models. The site tracks 222 compliance and regulation pages, and that body of work is relevant because payment timing and credit decisions sit inside rules about disclosure, fair lending, and record keeping.
sections.heading: Where the work stands

sections.body: The pages under this section fit together as a chain. Invoice Capture and Coding is the entry point, where documents become structured data. Customer Credit Risk sets the terms and limits before a sale. Programmable Settlement and Escrow handles the movement and conditional release of funds. Collections and Payment Plans covers what happens when payment is late or restructured. Working Capital Timing ties the whole cycle together by measuring when cash actually arrives and leaves, and a reader would go to each page for a specific stage, from intake to risk to settlement to recovery to timing.
